select ppd.*, prp.LOAN_INCOME_RIGHT as loanIncomeRightPrd, prp.DEBT_SECURITIES_INCOME_RIGHTS as debtSecuritiesIncomeRightsPrd, prp.RECEIVABLE_INCOME_RIGHTS as receivableIncomeRightsPrd, prp.OTHER_CREDITOR_RIGHTS as otherCreditorRightsPrd, prp.STOCK_INCOME_RIGHT as stockIncomeRightPrd, prp.OTHER_EQUITY_INCOME_RIGHTS as otherEquityIncomeRightsPrd, prp.PROPERTY_RIGHTS as propertyRightsPrd, prp.TOTAL as totalPrd from PBC_REPORT_ASSET_INCOME_DAT ppd left join PBC_REPORT_ASSET_INCOME prp on ppd.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and ppd.REPORTTYPE=prp.REPORTTYPE and ppd.propertyCode=prp.propertyCode where ppd.REPORTUUID = #{reportuuid,jdbcType=CHAR} and ppd.REPORTTYPE=#{reporttype,jdbcType=CHAR}

select prp.* from PBC_REPORT_ASSET_INCOME_DAT prp left join PBC_SEND_ZIP_DAT_FILE psz on psz.REPORTUUID=prp.REPORTUUID and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE =prp.REPORTTYPE where psz.DAT_ZIP_CODE=#{datZipCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and psz.DAT_ZIP_DAT_TYPE = #{datZipDatType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and prp.PROPERTYCODE is not null and (prp.LOAN_INCOME_RIGHT <> 0 or prp.DEBT_SECURITIES_INCOME_RIGHTS <> 0 or prp.RECEIVABLE_INCOME_RIGHTS <> 0 or prp.OTHER_CREDITOR_RIGHTS <> 0 or prp.STOCK_INCOME_RIGHT <> 0 or prp.OTHER_EQUITY_INCOME_RIGHTS <> 0 or prp.PROPERTY_RIGHTS <> 0 or prp.TOTAL <> 0)
